title: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 GGUF on llama.cpp (ggml-org)
slug_note: The official MXFP4 weights as one 63.4 GB GGUF, served by llama.cpp.

variation.quant_detail: MXFP4, 63.39 GB (gpt-oss-120b-MXFP4.gguf); the repo also holds an EAGLE3 draft model

engine.config: llama serve with the repo default

requirements.notes: Estimate: the 63.4 GB file plus KV cache. Not measured.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start).

caveats: No speed or memory numbers recorded yet.
`llama serve` is the newer unified llama.cpp command used on the ggml-org card; on older builds the equivalent server binary is `llama-server -hf ...`.
